right.scene: Simon Peter mid-leap, coat clutched around his body, plunging from the boat's edge toward the water.; Other disciples crowd the stern of the boat, one pointing toward the shore; a net full of fish trails in the water; a charcoal fire glows faintly on the beach.

left.scene: Peter, mid-stride, bending to grip the lame man's right hand and lift him upright.; John beside Peter; the seated beggar's alms bowl tipped on the steps; a watching crowd in the colonnade in Jewish and Gentile dress; Roman soldiers in plain tunics near the colonnade.

right.scene: Peter, standing still near the brazier with his face turned toward Jesus, his expression stricken.; Jesus, bound and guarded by soldiers, visible at the edge of the courtyard; townsfolk and servants around the fire looking away; a Roman soldier in military dress nearby.

left.scene: The Israelite people, families and herders in woven tunics and cloaks, walking across the dry sea-floor in a long column.; Moses in plain cloak with staff stands near the front edge of the path, arm lowered. Spray and sand blow across the open ground. Pillar of fire light lies over the water walls.

right.scene: Moses in a plain cloak, staff in his other hand, arm stretched out over the sea; Israelites in woven tunics and cloaks gathering at the shore; the east wind driving sand and spray across the open ground; radiance and cloud glowing in the night air above the parted waters
